programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Hurricanes and Golden Knights clash in Game 1 of the best-of-seven Stanley Cup Final. Carolina brings a stellar 12-1 playoff record into the series, while Vegas responds with a 12-5 postseason mark after sweeping its prior round.

programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Golden Knights play the Hurricanes at Lenovo Center in Game 2 of the Stanley Cup Final. Vegas leads 1-0 after a Game 1 win behind a goal and two assists from Shea Theodore and a career-first three-assist game from Brayden McNabb.

programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Hurricanes visit T-Mobile Arena to play the Golden Knights in Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final. The series remains tied after the Hurricanes orchestrated a wild third-period comeback, capped off by a Seth Jarvis power-play game-winner in overtime.

programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Golden Knights host the Hurricanes for Game 4 of the Stanley Cup Final. Vegas reclaimed the series lead after a 5-4 double-overtime win in Game 3, fueled by Mitch Marner's hat trick. Shea Theodore scored the winner after a late Carolina rally.

programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights and Carolina Hurricanes meet in Game 5 of the Stanley Cup Final. Hurricanes rely on Captain Jordan Staal after his iconic two goals in Game 4, while Vegas relies on forward Mitch Marner on the road. This series is tied 2-2.

programs.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programs.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights and Carolina Hurricanes meet in Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final. The visiting Hurricanes protect a 4-2 series edge behind goalie Brandon Bussi's 23 saves from Game 5, while Vegas counters with sharp offense on home ice.
